subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should plugin-runtime callers be permanently denied access to all legacy ownerless session rows, or should OpenClaw provide an explicit ownership migration or recovery path?
rationale: The PR intentionally changes upgrade behavior at a persisted-session authorization boundary, and repository source cannot establish the intended long-term security and compatibility policy.

options.title: Exact-owner fail closed
options.body: Reject foreign and ownerless rows while preserving operator and non-plugin recovery paths.

options.title: Add ownership migration
options.body: Provide a doctor or operator migration that safely assigns ownership before plugin-runtime mutation resumes.

options.title: Redesign plugin authority
options.body: Pause both candidate PRs and define a broader capability-based session authority contract.

recommendation.title: Exact-owner fail closed
recommendation.body: Reject foreign and ownerless rows while preserving operator and non-plugin recovery paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The current patch/projection ownership and migration ordering originate in this person's recent session-storage work.
